Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game. It may come as a surprise that Australia have dominated all three T20Is so far but they have played some tremendous cricket under David Warner. They have barged into the finals. England, on the other hand, need to win their next game if they want to make it through. They will be playing New Zealand next in Wellington on the 13th of February at 1900 local (0600 GMT). Do join us for that. You can now switch tabs to catch all the updates from the 4th ODI between South Africa and India. Cheers!

Winning skipper, David Warner, says the players are in tremendous form and are playing fearless cricket. Credits the bowlers for their performance. Further adds that all the bowlers have stuck to the plans and delivered. Appreciates D'Arcy Short for the way he has played. Ends by saying he is looking forward to the games in New Zealand.

Man of the Match, Kane Richardson, says he is surprised to be chosen for this award. Praises Marcus Stoinis and Ashton Agar for the way they bowled. States that they are enjoying their cricket and mentions that there is a lot of clarity in the team.

Losing captain, Jos Buttler, says he is disappointed with the performance. Admits nobody could kick on with the bat and they were outplayed by the Australians. Reckons that they have performed way below their ability. Ends by saying they are looking forward to their games in New Zealand.

Not a lot to say about the English bowling tonight. David Willey started off really well but received no support from the rest. Jordon did pick up two wickets but they weren't timely ones. They needed wickets in heaps and they also had to keep the runs down but failed in doing both. Join us for the presentation in a while.

To be honest, the match was set up by the bowlers of Australia and their batsmen did the finishing job. Chasing a target of 138, a total which many tipped to be below-par, the home side did get off to the worst of starts by losing Warner early. However, after that Lynn and Short combined to make full use of the Powerplay before the former departed towards the end of it. The English spinners did come on and bowled a few tight overs but once Glenn Maxwell and D'Arcy Short took them on, it all went awry for the touring team. Aaron Finch towards the end scored an unbeaten 5-ball 20 to score the remaining runs with utmost ease.

3 out of 3 for Australia and they march into the finals of the Tri-Series! Once again it has been a commendable performance from the Men in Yellow. They have made a mockery of the target set in front of them.

SIX! Yes he can! What a win here for Australia and they have finished it in style. Short and outside off, Finch upper cuts it over point and it has gone all the way. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS AND 33 BALLS TO SPARE!

SIX! That is a monster hit! He has picked the bones out of this one. WOW! What a hit, a full ball on middle, Finch lines it up and with a straight bat lofts it over the bowler's head for a hugeee one. 6 more needed. Can he finish it in one hit?
Down the leg side, Short flicks it to short fine leg for a quick run.
David Willey is back into the attack.
FOUR! Finch is not wasting time here! He gets a full ball on middle, tries to go big but it goes off the inner half through wide mid on. 13 more needed now.
FOUR! Short at the body, Finch tries to pull but it goes off the gloves down towards fine leg. The fielder there runs to his right, dives but all in vain. Australia inching closer here.
Down the leg side, Finch tries to flick but it goes off the pads on the leg side for a leg bye.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads, Short tries to flick but it goes off the pads to Buttler behind.
Aaron Finch comes out to bat.

OUT! Maxwell goes in an attempt to finish the game quickly. He has been dismissed for the first time in this series. He though falls after yet another good innings. A short ball by Jordon on middle, Maxwell moves his front leg out of the way and tries to pull it. He though is undone by the bounce and gets a top edge towards the keeper who does not make any mistake. 22 needed off 41 balls.
Chris Jordan is back on.
A full toss on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run. The two batsmen have eased out a little here now.
Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! England lose their sole review! A leg spinner down the leg side. Short tries to flick but it goes off something to the keeper who collects it and appeals. The umpire though shakes his head and Buttler after a chat with his bowler takes the review. They go upstairs and replays show it has hit the pad and there is no bat involved.
Review time! There is an appeal for a caught behind and Short is the man in question. The umpire shakes his head and Buttler takes the review. A review more in hope I would say.
Slower through the air outside off, Short guides it towards point. Maxwell wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
Adil is not afraid here to toss it up. He does so and Maxwell mistimes his heave down to long on for a run.
Flatter outside off, pushed through covers for a run.
Adil Rashid to bowl out. Only 27 needed now from 48 balls.
A full toss on the pads, this time a low one. Flicked down to fine leg to change strike.
A full toss, a high one. Close enough to be called a no ball but it isn't. Maxwell is surprised by it as he does not take full toll of it and strokes it down to long on for a run.
Another slower ball on the stumps, Maxwell hops and nudges it around the corner and some good running by the batsmen gives them two.
Slower ball down the leg side. The umpire stretches his arms.
A short ball, Maxwell goes for the upper cut but does not connect.
Slower ball on the pads, Short is happy to give the strike back to Maxwell as he flicks it down to fine leg.
A low full toss on middle, eased down to long on for a run.
Tom Curran is back into the attack.
Shorter in length outside off, cut through point for a run. 20 from the over, 34 needed now.

FOUR! Make that 19! There is no stopping Maxwell here. He gets a flighted ball on middle, Glenn heaves it not quite off the middle but in the gap in the mid-wicket region for another boundary. The 50-run stand is up and it has come in no time.
SIX! Dealing in boundaries here! Glenn is taking Rashid to the cleaners. Gives it air again on leg stump. Maxwell powers it over long on for a biggie. 15 from the over till now.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! 14 from his last 3. Rashid tosses it up on off, it is the googly. Maxwell picks it and hits it over the bowler's head.
FOUR! Maxwell is in a hurry here! Rashid bowls it flatter on off, Maxwell reverse sweeps it fine through third man and the ball races away. 10 from his last two.
Works it away with the turn towards mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Maxwell shows his aggressive side. Greets a fuller delivery around leg with a big swing of his bat and dismisses it over wide long on for a maximum. Massive over for Australia, 19 from it!
Short and outside off, hit through the line but straight to covers.
On the pads and nudged in the gap on the leg side for a run.
Short this time, outside off, cut behind point for a couple.
SIX! Clears long on this time. Tremendous bat speed. A loopy ball around off, spinning in and Short thwacks it over the fielder in the deep. Great connection, 10 from the over already.
FOUR! Floated and full around off, Short picks it up and muscles it with the spin to the long on fielder.

A clean reverse heave shot. Maxwell picks it from around leg and powers it with the spin. A bit of top edge but still it flies over backward point and short fine leg. The two fielders chase it but it's stopped by the sweeper cover who had come charging across. A couple results.
Second wrong 'un of the over. Around off, Maxwell probably picks it and keeps it out safely. Although all that happened through an inside edge.
Quicker delivery, flat and shorter on off, Maxwell makes room and slaps it through covers for a couple.
Spinning from around off, Maxwell reverse sweeps it but finds the short third man fielder.
Full flighted on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Googly on the shorter side outside off, a mistimed punch to sweeper cover.

Allows the ball to spin back in and works it through square leg for a run. They want the second run but then stop after watching the fielder in the deep rushing to the ball. He misfields but still they don't want to take any chance. 4 from this over as well.
Tossed up ball on middle, Maxwell kneels down and sweeps it in front of square leg for a run.
Another slider on middle, Maxwell defends it from the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Slider, around off and skidding in, Maxwell picks it late and keeps it out to mid-wicket.
Keeps his length short again, outside off, D'Arcy rocks back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Flatter and shorter on off, stroked to sweeper cover for one.
Liam Dawson to roll his arm now.
Around leg, Short fails to work it away. Tidy beginning by Rashid, only 4 runs off it!
Shortish again. Maxwell plays it to covers for one.
Shortish and turned behind square leg for one.
Very full and on middle, helped through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and on off, defended back off the front foot.
Full flighted on off, Short is on the front foot as he eases it down to long off for one.
Adil Rashid is brought into the attack.
Goes on his toes and defends a shorter one to the off side. 52/2 in the Powerplay, Australia will be reasonably happy with their position in this run chase.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Appeal for an lbw! A slower one this time, 100.4 kph, around leg, Short fails to pick it and misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Maybe, it pitched outside leg.
Glenn Maxwell arrives. He is fresh from a century and would like to repeat his performance. 87 needed more.

OUT! Lynn departs and it's a massive breakthrough for England. Big change in pace by Jordan, he bangs in a short ball at 144.6 kph, Lynn looks to take it on with the pull shot but fails to control it. Gets a top edge and Buttler moves across to his right to take the catch safely. End of another quickfire knock by Chris Lynn!
Slower delivery deceives the batsman. On a length around middle, Lynn is early into the shot and gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! Jesus, he is a killer of a cricket ball. What power he possesses! A full toss on middle and leg, Lynn bludgeons it over mid on for a boundary. You can softly loft it over the fielder and get the same number of runs, Chris.
In the blockhole, Short digs it out to end the over.
Fullish and angling down the leg side, Lynn fails to flick and it comes off his pads. They steal a leg bye.

SIX! This was on the cards but Willey made it easy for the batsman by bowling a full toss on the pads. All Lynn had to do was to lift it over backward square leg. Up and over the rope, all the pressure released.

Another play and a miss! Willey senses the charge from the batsman and bowls a short ball outside off, 134..3 kph, Lynn tries his best to put bat to ball but misses. Three dot balls, something is coming here...
Once again walks across the stumps and tries to work it away but misses. The slowness of the ball tricked him there.
Short and around middle, Lynn shuffles across the stumps with the hook shot but fails to connect.

FOUR! Goodness me, this shot is all about timing and placement. In this age of raw power, these type of shots always take the cake. Soothing to the eyes. An overpitched delivery around off, Short drives it crisply through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a glorious boundary.
A yorker follows, Lynn digs it out and runs across to the other end.
Swing and a miss! Jordan cooks up a fast short ball around middle, 141 kph, Lynn loses his shape while attempting the pull shot and hence misses. Jordan smiles.
Fuller and on middle, quietly pushed off the pads to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! You don't feed room to this batsman. Short and wide and D'Arcy smashes it past the point fielder. Third man had no chance of cutting it off.
Jordan bowls it down the leg side and gets away with it. Short fails to get any bat on it. A wide signalled.
Extra fielder on the off side for D'Arcy Short. An extra cover fielder in place. There is one slip too.
A length ball around off, hit through the line and the cover-point fielder gets some hand on it. Takes the pace off the ball and they cross for a single.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack. Slight hold up in play as the spider cam is stuck at the moment. Hanging right over the pitch. They are trying to get it fixed.
Angles in a length ball on off, D'Arcy pushes it to point. 6 from the over, a good one for England.
Another miss outside the off stump. Short needs to relax and watch the ball closely. There is no hurry as the required rate is well under control because of his partner.
Beaten again! Willey bowls an outswinger outside off, Short pushes inside the line and misses. Struggling to put bat on ball, the Big Bash hero!
Play and a miss! A length ball slanted into the batsman, around middle and leg, Short swings and misses.
Switches to over the wicket for the left-hander. Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Short fails to defend and is hit on the back leg.
Spears this one into the batsman, around leg, Lynn is beaten for pace as he tries to flick. It goes off his pads and they cross for a leg bye.
Five wides! England are feeling the pressure. Willey goes way down the leg side, Lynn fails to flick and the keeper only manages to get one hand on it. Fine leg is up and it races away to the fence.
Nearly carries to the fielder in the deep. A full toss on middle, Lynn pumps it over mid-wicket and the fielder in the deep charges forward. It falls just in front and they cross. 16 from the over!
SIX! This is into the crowd, 79m on the radar! Another slower one around off, fuller in length, Lynn once again picks it early and smokes it over the sightscreen. No holds barred.
FOUR! Curran attempts the slower one, bowls it just wide outside off, Lynn picks it early and whacks it through point for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! This is how he bats. A length ball around off, Lynn goes hard at it and misses.

FOUR! Shot! Curran bowls it short and around off, Lynn knows there is no fielder in the deep on the off side and takes the chance by powering it over the infield. Clears the cover fielder and fetches a boundary.
A little bit short and around off, Short punches it wide of mid off and takes a run.
Tom Curran to steam in from the other end.
FOUR! Take that for a reply! Willey offers width outside off, Lynn latches onto it and and slams it over cover-point for a cracking boundary.
Nearly chops it on. An inswinger first up to the new batsman, Lynn gets an inside edge onto the pads. In the last game, he was bowled to a similar delivery.
Chris Lynn is in next.

OUT! Australia lose Warner cheaply. Once again Willey has removed the Aussie skipper in the first over. A lovely outswinger has done the job. It's served around off, Warner shows no footwork as he tries to drive through the line. Gets a faint edge behind and Jos Buttler does the rest. Perfect start for England.
Angles in a length ball around off, Warner stays back and offers a straight bat in defense.
First runs. Warner picks the shortish length from outside off and turns it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Beaten first up! A back of a length delivery outside off, moving away through the air and off the pitch as well, Warner has a nervous push inside the line and misses.
Back for the second half. No tinkering with the openers. David Warner and D'Arcy Short walk out to initiate the run-chase. It will be David Willey to begin proceedings. All set, here we go...
